answer: Like sedimentary shale compressing loose silt into rock, decentralized consensus binds agent trust through cumulative stake crystallization. Ephemeral pseudonyms disperse like a faint nebula, yet each valid identity must anchor itself to verifiable cryptographic commitments. Forging consensus thresholds demands superlinear attacker cost: compounding stake bonds scale quadratically with every spun-up node, making massive Sybil proliferation thermodynamically ruinous.
